ref.note: OTW/TEC is financed under a public service contract (revised CSP approved 16/04/2026 with a multi-year budget trajectory, PDF p. 18), so changes pass through that contract. School transport organised by OTW includes transport of children with a disability (DF 045.010, PDF p. 16). Investment grants to OTW (infrastructure, fleet electrification DF 045.050, Charleroi metro) are also in this line but no longer have their own phrase. Some payments follow long-term commitments that cannot be changed quickly, e.g. SOFICO (DF 049.098) and the reimbursement to OTW of the costs of the Liège tram project (DF 045.023). The line is the whole DO 14: it also contains regional airports and aerodromes (14.046), sports infrastructure grants (14.047) and subsidised works for municipalities (14.048), not reflected in the phrases. corrected: quotes and pages confirmed in bud34. Point 7: dropped the fourth phrase (TEC infrastructure and electric buses), the weakest since it overlaps with the TEC phrase, and mentioned it in the caveat. School-transport phrase shortened (FR was 11 words) and uses the Flemish term 'leerlingenvervoer'; the disability detail moved to the caveat.
